FROM FORM TO FIRST ISSUE
Three steps. You're set.
1
Download your form
Export a bug report or feature request. Each form is a separate YAML file.
2
Add it to your repository
Place the file inside .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ on your repository's default branch.
3
Try a new issue
Open the repository's Issues tab and choose New issue to test your form.
